testo:
■ G-Neo Evolution: You may put this creature on top of one of your nature creatures.
■ Whenever this creature attacks, you may cast the spell side of one of your twinpact creatures in the battle zone without paying it's cost while it's in the battle zone.
■ At the start of your turn, if you have a creature that has power 12000 or more, you may return this creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Triple Breaker
testo_jp:

■ 自分のターンのはじめに、自分のパワー12000以上のクリーチャーがあれば、このクリーチャーを自分の墓地から手札に戻してもよい。
